title: donoteat this BONUS EPISODE 1: Black Wall Street
premise: The presenter traces Greenwood’s locally circulating wealth, the 1921 racist massacre and its recovery, arguing that later freeway and institutional redevelopment did more lasting damage by removing land from community use. He links racism, class power and community self-defense rather than treating prosperity as protection.
